title: Dhaaga Commercial & Business Administration Vocabulary Classification — approved staff-facing restriction policy
notes: APPROVED POLICY ONLY. Every row exists because a Business Owner decided it and recorded that decision in the Business Decision Record named by its bdr_reference. A commit, a pull request, a CI result or an engineering recommendation is not business approval.

This registry is deliberately NON-EXHAUSTIVE. It is not a vocabulary of Dhaaga, an accounting denylist, or a list of every candidate term discovered during analysis. A term that is absent is UNRESOLVED: no business decision exists for it, and it is not enforced.
Accounting is ONE DOMAIN within the broader commercial and business-administration vocabulary. An accounting term is not automatically restricted.

Enforcement is DERIVED: a term is enforced when decision_status is 'approved' and audience_policy is 'staff-restricted'. There is deliberately no stored 'enforced' field, because a stored flag can contradict the decision it claims to represent. scripts/scan_vocabulary.py refuses any row carrying an unrecognised field.

Vocabulary evolves through the Controlled Business Evolution Gate: business need -> business decision record -> approved policy update -> technical impact assessment -> implementation -> tests -> CI. Adding, amending, deferring or withdrawing a term is an ordinary business-policy change and does not reopen the architecture.
There is no bypass. No inline allowlist, developer comment, exception file, environment variable or CI skip exists in V1.

scope.non_staff_prefix_evidence: lib/l10n/app_en.arb declares the gallery key group as non-staff in its own metadata: @galleryTitle.description reads 'Title of the WP-9 acceptance artefact. Not a business screen.' Eight of the catalogue's 42 message keys carry this prefix (galleryTitle, gallerySectionMoney, gallerySectionMeasurement, gallerySectionStatus, gallerySectionReason, gallerySectionOffline, gallerySectionStates, galleryLargeText), leaving 34 staff-facing. This is the current WP-9 convention, not a permanent multi-audience architecture.
scope.unclassified_keys_are: staff-facing — a new key nobody classified is protected, not exempt

terms.reason: Prevents internal commercial/accounting terminology from unintentionally appearing in staff-facing language, while allowing Dhaaga's business vocabulary to evolve through controlled business governance. Restricted from English staff-facing message values only; the term remains valid in internal, administrative, technical, accounting, database and other non-staff-facing contexts.
